description: Architecture map of the Repeg Club platform on Terra Classic: 3 minigames (Wheel of Repeg, Weekly Round, Create Your Own Luck), their contracts, the React frontend, the keeper bot, and the deploy/verification pipeline. Nodes are components; edges are real relationships (signs, calls, automates, hosts, deploys); flows are ordered, named sequences through the graph for common real-world paths.

nodes.label: Player / Creator
nodes.description: Anyone with a Keplr wallet - buys tickets, creates raffles, or just verifies a result. No account, no signup.

nodes.label: Keplr Wallet
nodes.description: Browser extension holding the private key. Every transaction is signed here - the frontend never sees a key.

nodes.label: Frontend (React + Vite SPA)
nodes.description: Single static single-page app, 4 routes, built with @goblinhunt/cosmes for chain access. 100% static - no backend of its own.

nodes.label: Wheel of Repeg  (/)
nodes.description: Flagship game: buy a ticket, win the right to repeg your own USTC to USDC 1:1.

nodes.label: Weekly Round  (/weekly-round)
nodes.description: Platform-wide jackpot fed by every Wheel of Repeg round plus its own daily-rising ticket price.

nodes.label: Create Your Own Luck  (/create-your-own-luck)
nodes.description: Discovery feed of every raffle (read from the factory) plus the creator form.

nodes.label: Raffle detail  (/create-your-own-luck/:address)
nodes.description: One page per raffle: fund, buy tickets, close, draw/execute, reveal, verify, claim.

nodes.label: tokenPrices.ts
nodes.description: Fetches real LUNC/USTC market prices so the safety checklist can price a non-USDC prize correctly instead of assuming 1:1.

nodes.label: Verification panels
nodes.description: Recomputes a draw's SHA-256 client-side from public chain data (block hash, entrant list) - anyone can check a result wasn't rigged, without trusting the site.

nodes.label: CoinGecko API
nodes.description: Public, keyless price API - informational only, never gates a transaction.

nodes.label: Terra Classic RPC / LCD
nodes.description: rebel-2 testnet today; the same code targets columbus-5 mainnet by swapping one config value.

nodes.label: Wheel Manager contract
nodes.description: CosmWasm/Rust. Ticket pool -> block-hash draw -> winner gets the right to redeem their own USTC for USDC 1:1.

nodes.label: Weekly Round contract
nodes.description: One grand prize per week, topped up by every Wheel Manager round plus its own rising-price ticket sales.

nodes.label: CYOL Factory contract
nodes.description: Instantiates a fresh, independent raffle contract per creator (CosmWasm submessage + reply) and keeps the public on-chain registry - also owns the creator cooldown anti-abuse mechanism.

nodes.label: CYOL Raffle instance
nodes.description: One immutable contract per raffle. SingleWinner, Podium, or Airdrop - prize in LUNC, USDC, or USTC.

nodes.label: Keeper bot (Node.js)
nodes.description: Polls chain state and calls CloseRound/DrawWinner (or CloseWeek/DrawWeeklyWinner) the instant either is eligible - deliberately dumb/immediate, which is what actually defeats block-grinding. Does NOT watch Create Your Own Luck: its creator decides when to reveal to their own community.

nodes.label: Oracle Cloud VM
nodes.description: Always-Free tier VM. Runs the keeper as a systemd service with auto-restart, confirmed to recover in seconds after a crash or reboot.

nodes.label: GitHub (private repo)
nodes.description: Source of truth. Work happens on branches + PRs, never direct pushes to main, while CodeRabbit's free tier lasts.

nodes.label: CodeRabbit
nodes.description: Automated PR review - catches real bugs before merge (denom mismatches, stale-state races, missing bounds checks) across dozens of PRs so far.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages
nodes.description: Builds and deploys the frontend automatically on every push to main. No server to maintain, HTTPS by default.

edges.relation: triggers build on push to main

flows.label: Buy a Wheel of Repeg ticket
flows.summary: The core, most-repeated action on the platform.

steps.description: Opens repegclub.com and connects Keplr.
Approves the BuyTicket transaction (amount + memo "REPEG CLUB").
The ticket booth submits the signed transaction to the contract.
BuyTicket executes: pool grows, ticket recorded, rolling deadline resets.
Transaction confirms; the frontend refetches and the pool/ticket count update live.

flows.label: A round closes and draws itself
flows.summary: No human needs to be present for a round to resolve.

steps.description: The always-on VM keeps the keeper process alive.
Wakes on its poll interval, checks every watched round's eligibility.
Once max players or the rolling deadline is reached, it fires CloseRound then DrawWinner.
The winner is derived from a future block's hash - unknown to anyone when the round closed.
Any player can now hit "Reveal winner" and watch the wheel land - no spoilers beforehand.

flows.label: Winner redeems USTC for USDC
flows.summary: The entire point of the game: a personal repeg, funded by the pool.

steps.description: The winning wallet opens the redeem box, sees the exact USTC amount before signing.
Redeem is submitted with the chosen USTC amount attached.
Redeem swaps the attached USTC for USDC 1:1 from the round's escrow, tax-free (funds attached to a contract call aren't taxed).
Confirmed on-chain; lifetime stats and the platform-wide "USTC repegged" counter update.

flows.label: Create a raffle (Create Your Own Luck)
flows.summary: Anyone can become a creator - no admin approval, no separate account.

steps.description: Opens the "I'm a creator" form: raffle type, ticket price, min/max players, prize asset.
Signs CreateRaffle - this signature *is* the creation, there's no draft to save.
The factory receives CreateRaffle.
Runs the creator-cooldown check, then instantiates a brand-new raffle contract via submessage.
The reply captures the new contract's real address.
A fresh, immutable contract now exists - status Funding, waiting for its creator.

flows.label: Fund and open a raffle
flows.summary: Where the safety checklist matters most - real money is about to commit.

steps.description: The creator returns to their raffle's page to fund it.
The page checks the planned prize's real market value.
Converts the prize (LUNC/USDC/USTC) to a real USD-equivalent, not a naive 1:1 assumption.
If the prize is worth less than a single ticket, a checkbox-gated warning blocks funding until confirmed.
PayServiceFee + DepositPrize execute; status flips to Open.

flows.label: Buy a raffle ticket and reveal the result
flows.summary: Same anti-grinding spirit as Wheel of Repeg, but the creator - not a bot - decides when to draw.

steps.description: Buys one or more tickets in a single signed transaction.
BuyTicket records the entry; hitting max_players closes and draws atomically in the same call.
For SingleWinner, the creator alone calls DrawWinner - their moment to announce to their own community.
SingleWinner reveals via the wheel; Airdrop reveals via a wallet-gated treasure chest showing that wallet's own share.

flows.label: Publicly verify any draw
flows.summary: The trust mechanism: nobody has to take the site's word for a result.

steps.description: Opens "Verify this round" on any drawn round or raffle - works for a stranger's browser too.
Independently queries the real block (by height) and the real entrant list from chain.
Recomputes SHA-256(round id, block height, block time, entrants) from scratch, client-side.
The recomputed hash is compared against the on-chain winner - match or mismatch, shown plainly.

flows.label: Real-time safety checklist (Create Your Own Luck)
flows.summary: 5 independent signals, never averaged into one score, so one bad signal can't hide behind good ones.

steps.description: Any visitor sees the checklist before deciding to buy in - not creator-only.
Fundraiser-vs-giveaway and prize-vs-ticket value both route through real prices.
Prices the prize in its real asset, not an assumed 1:1 with USDC.
GetCreatorCooldown is polled to flag a creator repeating small, paid raffles.
Wallet concentration and self-buy are computed live from the entrant list, polled every 12s.

flows.label: Ship a change to production
flows.summary: Every push to main is live within minutes, with an automated reviewer in between.

steps.description: A branch is pushed and a PR opened - direct pushes to main are avoided by convention.
CodeRabbit reviews automatically, usually within a minute.
Real findings get fixed before merge, not rubber-stamped.
On merge, Cloudflare picks up the push to main.
Builds the Vite app and deploys - no manual step, no server to touch.
repegclub.com serves the new build within minutes.
